title: Author replies privately to a reader's feedback from the report's admin view, and the reader sees their own feedback and the replies beneath the feedback box
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: The admin feedback view offers the author a reply form on each feedback message: missing
POST /admin/feedback/{n}/reply stores the author's reply to that message (adminRoutes row, adminFeedbackReply, feedback.OwnerReplyTarget and feedback.OwnerReply): missing
The author's admin view shows each reply beneath the message it answers (Message.Replies filled by OwnerInbox): missing
The reader sees their own feedback and the author's replies beneath the feedback box when they next open the report (SenderThreads, readerData.OwnFeedback, <ol class="own-feedback">): missing
The reply stays private between the author and that reader: other readers and anonymous visitors see neither the message nor the reply, and only the owner can post a reply: missing

E-005's finish test (third done_when line: the reply written from the admin view shows with the reader's own message beneath the box, and no other reader or anonymous visitor sees either) passes: missing

No cap or paging on the owner's inbox (deferred finding m5). Open question Q-023 says no cap until SC-021/E-006, and the design adds none. As built, every admin message article now carries a textarea and a button, so the page grows with the number of messages. A shared reply form or paging is a later lever.
feedback from blocked accounts is still stored but not marked on the admin page. The design leaves that to SC-021.

Decide the owner-inbox bound (a cap, paging or one shared reply form) before the feedback volume is large. Every admin article now has a textarea and a button, and lesson #960 puts per-item forms at about 2 MB per 10,000 items. Q-023 is the question.

Case (m)'s script, tests/acceptance/test_e005_1_private_feedback.py, exists only in the ledger. Whoever plants the finish test should confirm it exits 0 from the repo root, or the file should be placed in the repo.

Signed-in pages (the admin reply form and the reader's own thread) can't be opened by the engine with a bare command, because config refuses to start without HBAND_* variables. I looked at them with a one-off overlay probe in real Chrome (about 3 s); a committed signed-in browser test would make that repeatable. This is the same wall as lesson #961.

The fitness.yaml text for 'only the reader page reads a sender's own feedback thread' still says 'Quiet until SC-017 adds the method'. It is stale now that the method exists; I left the configuration alone.

deviation: OwnerReply returns only an error, not the (int64, error) the design names. This follows the accepted m1 change that made Send return only an error. The only caller is the owner's route, which needs no id, and nothing would call the returned value; TestOwnerReplyReturnsNoID pins it.
